cases.name: Stacy Mondal
cases.about:
Her Go Fund Me said, "Stacy was the heart and soul of her family, a dedicated mother to her five beautiful children, aged 17, 15, 11, 1, and just 2 months old. Her unwavering love and devotion to her children were evident in her constant presence on the sidelines, cheering them on in all their endeavors.

Family gatherings held a special place in Stacy's heart, and she never missed an opportunity to celebrate life's precious moments with her loved ones. As a daughter, sister to three brothers, and a terrific aunt, she brought immense joy and warmth to her family."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot and killed her in front of her two young children in their vehicle J.C. Penney store for a photo shoot with their two children. Her autopsy revealed she sustained seven gunshot wounds, and bullets struck her heart, lungs, and liver.
